entities.summary: Dick Sand, A Captain at Fifteen is a Jules Verne novel published in 1878. It deals primarily with the issue of slavery, and the African slave trade by other Africans in particular. Dick Sand, A Captain at Fifteen is a literary work by Jules Verne. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
